cohort: Participants were pregnant women with single, live births over 24 weeks gestation, treated at a high-complexity hospital in Cauca, Colombia.
finding: The study found that prior cesarean section, obesity, nulliparity, non-cephalic presentations, and moderate/high risk classifications were significantly associated with cesarean section.
